repository.purpose: Wraps internal-media-core local media streams with Webex server-mute authority and unmute gating, and re-exports the media and effects surface as one published SDK entry point.

media-helpers-sdk.summary: Published npm package surface declared by package.json (main dist/index.js, types emitted by build:src). Exports local and remote stream classes, stream factory functions, camera constraint presets, and the re-exported media-effects surface; the exact export list is src/index.ts.

media-helpers-server-mute-internal.summary: Internal server-mute control pair setUnmuteAllowed and setServerMuted, marked @internal and stripped from published declarations by the stripInternal compiler option, consumed in-repo by @webex/plugin-meetings.

internal-media-core-sdk.summary: Upstream local and remote stream base classes and capture factories that this package subclasses and delegates to.

web-media-effects-sdk.summary: Upstream virtual-background and noise-reduction effects re-exported unchanged through this package's entry point.

ts-events-sdk.summary: Typed event primitives AddEvents, TypedEvent, and WithEventsDummyType used to add the server-mute event to the stream classes.

module_docs_decision.reason: The confirmed boundary is the whole package, whose code lives under src/. The package spec is published at the package documentation entry point docs/README.md rather than src/docs/README.md, because the monorepo .gitignore rule packages/**/docs/ was negated only for the package-level docs directory and a spec nested under src/ would remain untracked. Owner confirmed the single-module boundary and that README.md stays at the package root.

The package exposes a published SDK surface and owns no HTTP surface, so it retains its ecosystem-native API artifact instead of an OpenAPI document.
Security policy is owned at the monorepo level rather than per workspace package; no package-level policy exists and none was selected.
Contribution instructions are owned at the monorepo root, which the package README already links to.
Releases and changelog generation are driven at the monorepo root by standard-version; the package keeps no separate changelog.
The CTO readiness workflow targets deployable services; this package is a published library.
Omitted together with CTO_CHECKLIST.yml, which the two artifacts require.
